Prawn cocktail for the whole hotel.d: Six, poached and chilled, on shredded iceberg with rosy tomato mayonnaise, lemon and paprika.
Prawn cocktail for the whole hotel.note: Passed through the box seats all night.

Caviar blini.d: Warm buckwheat pancakes, crème fraîche, salmon roe, chives.
Caviar blini.note: Made to order. Allow twenty minutes.

Surf and turf.d: An eight ounce filet mignon seared to order and a lobster tail broiled in garlic butter. Béarnaise.
Surf and turf.note: The most expensive thing on the card. Thirty even.

Rare stamp shortbread.d: Butter shortbread cut with a pinked edge, each piped with an iced stamp. Six to a plate.
Rare stamp shortbread.note: Iced like the real thing. Do not mail.

Monty's champagne cocktails for the bar.d: A sugar cube soaked in bitters, orange liqueur, chilled brut to the brim and a twist of peel.
